network.scope: scripts/github_discovery.py may search exact repository names and verify matching remote SKILL.md files for family-primary Skills that lack a repository; scripts/github_preview.py may read verified or locally observed public repositories and allowlisted preview images; scripts/description_queue.py may read one bounded README excerpt for the same repository. All use HTTPS, fixed hosts, timeouts, and byte limits. --no-github-discovery disables discovery, --no-github-images disables preview reads, and --no-github-readmes disables README queue reads.
network.reason: The catalog must recover missing repository links conservatively and use the corresponding verified project repository as the default preview-image source when one is available.

file_write.scope: Only the explicitly selected Agent Skill Catalog output directory may receive catalog.json and index.html; scanned roots remain read-only.
file_write.reason: The user explicitly authorized this local Agent Skill Catalog implementation and refresh; this approval does not authorize writes outside the selected output directory.

subprocess.scope: The local server may invoke only scripts/build_catalog.py with fixed startup config, curation files, output directory, and --refresh; HTTP requests cannot supply command arguments. The discovery script may invoke read-only gh auth token --hostname github.com to reuse an existing local login; no credential is written.
subprocess.reason: The page refresh button needs the fixed local builder process; this approval does not authorize arbitrary commands or HTTP-provided paths.
